Datacenter status covers equipment in professionally managed facilities that meets Vast's partner requirements. [Vast Compliance — Secure Cloud](https://vast.ai/compliance) describes Secure Cloud eligibility; Vast's [January 2024 datacenter article](https://vast.ai/article/Navigating-Data-Center-Compliance) describes a blue datacenter label. Confirm the applicable certification requirements below before applying. ## Benefits - Vast's [January 2024 datacenter article](https://vast.ai/article/Navigating-Data-Center-Compliance) describes a blue datacenter label. - Secure Cloud search eligibility, described under Secure Cloud (Trusted Datacenters) on the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance). - The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Priority Placement, describes higher search placement for certified machines. - The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Dedicated Support, describes direct access to Vast’s team for onboarding, troubleshooting, and operational support. ## Requirements - Confirm the applicable certification requirement with Vast's datacenter Product/Compliance team: the current [Compliance page — Secure Cloud](https://vast.ai/compliance) says ISO 27001 and SOC 2 are encouraged but not strictly required, while the [October 2024 security article — Third-Party Certifications](https://vast.ai/article/security-and-compliance-at-vast-ai) describes ISO 27001 as a minimum. These published sources differ. - Equipment must be owned by a registered business. See [Certified Data Center program, Verified Business](https://vast.ai/data-center-application). - For Secure Cloud datacenter partners, the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance), under Auditing & oversight, describes audits of ownership structure, identity, and source of funds. The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Verified Business, separately requires equipment owned by a registered business and owner identity verification. - A signed expanded hosting agreement with Data Processing Agreement coverage, as described under Legal & Contractual Protections on the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance). Obtain the current datacenter agreement during the application process. - Owner identity verification. See Auditing & oversight on the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance). - At least 5 GPU servers with flagship-class hardware, as listed on [Vast Compliance — Secure Cloud](https://vast.ai/compliance). If the servers are not yet listed, confirm with the datacenter team what evidence of equipment they accept during application. ## Apply Prepare: - Government-issued ID for business owner(s). - Business registration or certificate of good standing. - Datacenter name, address, and certificates. - Contract or invoice linking the business to the datacenter. - Any additional due-diligence documents Vast requests. Apply at [vast.ai/data-center-application](https://vast.ai/data-center-application).
